I was in a car accident a month ago. My mom was driving us home from Starbucks, we were driving 60mph down the highway. My mom was attentive and driving safely. Unfortunately, three teenagers in a truck failed to yield to a stop sign, running right in front of us. We t-boned them, as we had absolutely no time to react. My mom slammed on her brakes as soon as she saw them pull in front of us. Us going 60mph on impact caused their truck to flip over into a ditch, and our car to spin out. The three teenagers survived with absolutely no injuries, while my mom had a concussion and I broke my spine. Paramedics told us that with how bad the impact was, they were surprised it didn't kill us. Teenagers should NEVER drive with more than one friend in the car, as it has been statistically proven that the more friends in a teenagers car, the more distracted they get. Those teenagers who failed to stop at a stop sign almost cost my mom and I's life, I'm even shocked that the teenagers weren't injured themselves despite their vehicle flipping over. It could've been much worse, and I'm glad nobody died- but we very easily could've died. The odds were not in our favor at all but we made it out alive.
